title: The Central 1000 au of a Pre-stellar Core Revealed with ALMA. I. 1.3 mm Continuum Observations
question: What is the structure of the central ~1000 au of the pre-stellar core L1544 in 1.3 mm dust continuum, and is there real fragmentation or are substructures interferometric artefacts?

what.value: L1544 density profile n0=1.6e6 cm-3, Rflat=17.3", alpha=2.6

evidence.loc: 4.3 Structure derived from single dish observations

what.value: Bonnor-Ebert sphere model of L1544 with temperature gradient

evidence.quote: The model is generated using the physical parameters found by (cite: KC10) and refined by (cite: KRC14)

external_data.citation: Keto & Caselli 2010 (cite: KC10); Keto et al. 2014 (cite: KRC14)

evidence.quote: Assuming a dust temperature $T_d$ = 6.5 K (cite: CCW07; KC10)

external_data.citation: Crapsi et al. 2007 (cite: CCW07); Keto & Caselli 2010

evidence.quote: a dust opacity at 1.3 mm $\kappa_{\rm 1.3mm}$ = 0.009 cm$^2$ g$^{-1}$ (cite: OH94)

recipe.goal: Calibrate and jointly image ACA+12m continuum
recipe.method: Calibrate in CASA, reweight with statwt, joint multi-scale mfs clean

recipe.goal: Derive kernel radius, mass and density
recipe.method: Kernel radius from 5 sigma contour; mass from optically thin dust emission formula; mean H2 density from sphere
key_parameters: flux integrated within 5 sigma contour and 50% primary beam response: 42±2 mJy
assumptions: Td = 6.5 K, kappa1.3mm = 0.009 cm2/g, D = 135 pc

recipe.method: Mass within 11 sigma contour in 12m map; Jeans length for isothermal cloud
assumptions: T = 6.5 K, uniform spherical kernel density 4.5e-18 g/cm3

recipe.method: simobserve of model image for ACA and 12m, imaged with same parameters

recipe.goal: Fit smooth elongated model and test substructure
recipe.method: Fit F(r)=F0/(1+(r/Rflat)^alpha) with elliptical radius by chi2 minimisation over 50% PB region; simulate observations, residuals; 100 simulations with different hour angles using baselines >13 klambda, natural weighting
Simulated ALMA observations of spherical profile from Chacon-Tanarro et al.

recipe.goal: MHD/HD simulations and synthetic ALMA observations
recipe.method: ZeusTW non-ideal MHD and HD turbulent simulations; RADMC-3D temperature; simulated ALMA 12m observations at peak densities 2e6, 5e6, 1e7 cm-3
key_parameters: Mc=8.1 Msun, Rc=5e4 au, B0≈14.8 uG, Mach 5 turbulence, tilt 45 deg

evidence.quote: derived from the area within the 5 $\sigma$ contour of the combined map is 10.3$''$  (1446 au)
(42$\pm$2 mJy, taking into account a 5% calibration error)

answer_key.quantity: Average H2 number density in kernel

evidence.quote: is 0.003 M$_{\odot}$ (3 M$_{\rm J}$), i.e. each fragment is about 1 M$_{\rm J}$
the Jeans length of the kernel is about 3200 au
which yields $\phi\approx45^{\circ}$ for the kernel of L1544
